Research is collaborative. The people below include long-standing collaborators, recent collaborators, and students whose projects I have supervised.

## Collaborators

<div>
<strong>Group illustration to be added</strong>
Robie A. Hennigar · Pablo A. Cano · Javier Moreno · Ángel J. Murcia

Robie A. Hennigar, Pablo A. Cano, Javier Moreno and Ángel J. Murcia have been among my **main and most frequent collaborators**, spanning different stages of my career and a broad range of topics in gravitational physics, black holes, higher-curvature gravity, holography and quantum field theory. In particular, my collaborations with **Robie A. Hennigar** and **Pablo A. Cano** extend over many years and a substantial fraction of my work on higher-curvature gravity and black-hole physics.

### Other recent collaborators

Since 2022, my papers have also included collaborations with **César A. Agón, Horacio Casini, Roberto Emparan, Guido van der Velde, Quim Llorens, Óscar Lasso Andino, Aitor Vicente-Cano, Adam F. García, Francesco Gentile, Alejandro Vilar López, Valentín Benedetti, Javier Magán, Alberto Rivadulla Sánchez, Mengqi Lu, Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez, Giorgos Anastasiou, Ignacio J. Araya, Rodrigo Olea, Adem D. Piskin** and others.
